author: Good Enough
description:
A blizzard can become deadly fast, with extreme cold, powerful winds, and near-zero visibility making it easy to get lost or develop hypothermia. Knowing where to shelter, how to stay warm, and what to do if you become stranded can greatly improve your chances of survival.

This Short explains how to survive a blizzard, what to do during a whiteout, how to avoid hypothermia and frostbite, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during extreme winter weather.
title: How to Survive a Deadly Blizzard 🌨️🥶 #outdoors #naturaldisaster #survival #survivaltips
